normal.expected: Descriptor closes after exclusive lock release.
normal.observation: Observe lock ownership and descriptor closure on return.

error.expected: Descriptor closes if acquire or the body raises; explicit unlock errors are suppressed before close.
error.observation: Inject acquire, body and release errors.

cancellation.expected: Cancellation of an outer awaiter does not release this worker lock.
cancellation.observation: Observe worker completion and lock release.

timeout.expected: A blocked caller is not proof of an abandoned descriptor.
timeout.observation: Observe contending process and descriptor lifecycle.

retry.expected: Only EDEADLK retries the blocking byte-lock operation on the same descriptor.
retry.observation: Inject EDEADLK followed by success or terminal error.
